StructElement.description:
The name and value pair options to control the export session behavior. The supported options are:
1. pkgDatasetName: valid values are "Dataset name", specifies the output briefcase Dataset name.
2. revRule: valid values are "Revision Rule name", specifies the Reivsion Rule that will be applied on the root object for configured BOM export.
3. varRule: valid values are "Variant Rule name", specifies the Variant Rule that associated to the root object for configured BOM export.
4. dry_run: valid values are True/False, specifies that the briefcase export report is generated which has discrepancy if any.
5. validateXML: valid values are True/False, specifies that the TCXML is validated against any discrepancy.
6. validateXMLBeforeXslt: valid values are True/False, specifies that the TCXML is validated before mapping is done.
7. modified_objects_only: valid values are True/False, specifies the option for delta export.
8. opt_sync_previous_delta: valid values are True/False, specifies the option for force re-export.
9. OwnershipTransfer: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to do ownership transfer.
10. objsForOwnXfer: valid values are in the format of "<site-id>:<object-uid1,object-uid2…>", specifies the objects for ownership transfer.
11. processUnconfiguredVariants: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to process the BOMLines that are configured out by the Variant Rule.
12. processUnconfiguredByOccEff: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to process the BOMLines that are configured out by Occurrence Effectivity.
13. processSuppressedOcc: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to process the suppressed BOMLines.
14. processUnconfiguredChanges: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to process the BOMLines that are configured out by Incremental Change.
15. ContinueOnError: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to continue the export on partial error.
StructElement.name: sessionOptions

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation recovers the site ownership of all the objects associated with a briefcase transaction that includes ownership transfer (OT). This operation makes objects locally owned when run on exporting site and as replica if run on importing site. The current user will be notified once the operation is complete, and a report will be generated. This report lists the objects for which ownership has been recovered. The operation also supports a dry run mode to review the objects for which ownership would be changed before actually applying the ownership changes. The current user will be notified, and a report will be generated in order to review the objects that are candidates for ownership recovery.
This will recover the ownership only if briefcase was exported or imported by the current logged in user or current logged in user is DBA.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::TCXMLImportExport::Briefcase::recoverOwnershipInBriefcase
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
Errors if any are returned in the ServiceData.
The following errors may be returned:
11128: The given string is not a valid UID
11223: No read access for briefcase OT transaction.
11230: For given input briefcase, there are either no objects found to recover the ownership or the wnership had already been recovered.

OperationParameter.description: The UID of the Briefcase that includes OT for the recovery of ownership of its associated objects.
OperationParameter.name: briefcaseUID

OperationParameter.description:
If true, the ownerhip of the objects will not change and the user will be notified. The report will have details of all candidate objects for which the ownership would change.
If false, the ownership of the objects will change and the user will get notified. The report will be generated, which has information about the objects whose ownership is recovered.
OperationParameter.name: dryRun

OperationParameter.description: If true, the operation will be performed in background mode in a separate asynchronous server session; otherwise, the operation will be performed synchronously.
OperationParameter.name: runInBackground

Condition.description: This condition determines if instances of a particular business object type can be checked-in from briefcase export. This depends upon the following checks: if the instance is briefcase checked-out; if the instance is local or the briefcase checked-out site is the current site; if the user is the briefcase checked-out user or the user is from dba group.
Condition.expression: o.checked_out = "Y" AND u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj( o, "reservation", "site_reserved" ) = "true" AND ( o.owning_site = null OR ( o.owning_site != null AND u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0GetPropertyValue( u.site, "object_string", u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj( o, "reservation", "remote_site" ), false ) ) ) AND ( u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0GetPropertyValue( u.user, "object_string", u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj( o, "reservation", "user_object" ), false ) OR u.group_name = "dba" )
Condition.name: Awp0BriefcaseCheckinCmdCond

Condition.description: This condition determines if instances of a particular business object type can be checked-out for briefcase export. This depends upon the following checks: if the instance is checkout-able; if the instance is modifiable at the current site; if the type is in the preference Briefcase_checkout_supported_types defined supported type list.
Condition.name: Awp0BriefcaseCheckoutCmdCond

Condition.description: This condition determines if instances of a particular business object type can be cancelled checked-out for briefcase export. This depends upon the following checks: if the instance is briefcase checked-out; if the instance is local or the briefcase checked-out site is the current site; if the user is the briefcase checked-out user or the user is from dba group.
Condition.expression: o.checked_out = "Y" AND u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj( o, "reservation", "site_reserved" ) = "true" AND ( o.owning_site = null OR ( o.owning_site != null AND u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0GetPropertyValue( u.site, "object_string", u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj( o, "reservation", "remote_site" ), false ) ) ) AND ( u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0GetPropertyValue( u.user, "object_string", u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj( o, "reservation", "user_object" ), false ) OR u.group_name = "dba" )
Condition.name: Awp0CancelBriefcaseCheckoutCmdCond

Condition.description: This condition determines if instances of a particular business object type can be marked for site ownership transfer for briefcase export. This depends upon the following checks: if the instance is local object; if the instance is modifiable at the current site; if the object is not checked out; if the instance has not been marked for site ownership transfer already; if the type is in the preference Briefcase_ownership_transfer_supported_types defined supported type list.
Condition.expression: o.isReplica() = false AND o.is_modifiable = true AND o.checked_out != "Y" AND u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0isObjectTypePresentInPref("Briefcase_ownership_transfer_supported_types",o)=true
Condition.name: Awp0MarkOwnershipTransferCmdCond

Condition.description: This condition determines the visibility of the "Awp0ViewOwnershipTransfer" command.
Condition.name: Awp0ViewOwnershipTransferCmdCond
